notes: Six own pages read (home, pricing, about, security, the case management product page and the personal injury page), all HTTP 200 and not thin. Cause checks: taqtics.com read (HTTP 200, does not carry the add-on list); research.com and selecthub.com both answered 403 and were not retried; they were tried for C05/C06's add-on sentence, which needs no cause once C06 is unverifiable. quickbase.com (cited by the q10 Claude answers) was already read under the cosmolex budget and carries the 200,000+ figure (C15). C15 compares 'legal professionals' with the about page's '100,000 Filevine Users'; the same page also says 6,000 clients and 'over 6,500 customers', which no answer states. C03 is true only through LOIS Explore, a free tier of the LOIS AI product without case management. q6 Claude's add-on list was split: eSignature and business insights (C05, true) and document management and assembly (C06, unverifiable because the page frames packages as custom built). The home page field in page-candidates.json was ignored; https://filevine.com/ was read. Not coded: capability and fit descriptions (workflow customization, AI case intelligence, texting, deadline tracking, timekeeping and LEDES billing), 'typically higher-end' pricing comparisons, hedged lines ('can involve tiered pricing'), ratings, and the 'PI module' wording. Pass 2 (8 Oct 2026): no browser reads exist for this vendor; the two blocked pages are third-party cause pages, not own pages, so no claim was re-classed. The gaps file and the answers' tables and sub-headings add no in-scope statement (every Custom or Quote-based pricing cell is already an instance of C01). Consistency check: C15 kept wrong; the about page's 100,000 Filevine Users counts the same unit as the claimed 200,000+ legal professionals and the claimed floor is twice the published count, although the same page gives two different customer figures (6,000 clients and over 6,500 customers).
